theorem.label: ds-treewidth
theorem.statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides Dominating Set within the stated running time. f(k) 2^(o_eff(t)) B^(O(1)). The graph is connected and bipartite. The prefactor f is any total computable positive integer-valued function of the solution budget k. The exponent h is computable and nonnegative integer-valued. There is a computable function T such that h(t) ≤ η max(t, 1) whenever t ≥ T(η), for each positive rational η.
